After harvesting rice, you'll also pick makomo dake (a water plant considered a luxury ingredient in China) and take it home with you.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000, elementary school age and under ¥2,000 (includes guide, snacks, and insurance)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Sayuri Gakudou Club, Nishimura Jun

【What to bring】Drinks, ground sheet, work gloves, hat, clothes you don't mind getting dirty, rubber boots, old socks, rain gear, towel, change of clothes

【More info】Sayuri Kindergarten website: https://www.hannousayuri.com/
